messages.subject: New version - phyloPCA and PaCA
parts:
Dear Dean, Mike and Antigoni, I realized that is out a new version of geomorph with exiting new capabilities like phyloPCA and PaCA. In the vignettes all this new functionality is managed through the new function gm.prcomp (and related functions) that “is for performing principal components analyses on Procrustes shape variables for a set of aligned specimens”. I’d like to know if is possible to use linear morphometric variables, as logshape ratios with this new functions or if they are restricted to only GM data.

Kind regards,

Alejo

Alejo,

The gm.prcomp function wraps a function called ordinate one the RRPP package. That one might be more straightforward without shale data, but either will work without shape data. 

Mike
